tools.name: discoverServers
tools.description: Discover tools and articles which can be invoked through this gateway. Describe the task you are working on in natural language; returns a ranked list of ready-to-invoke actions, each with its tool schema, price and quality statistics, ready to pass to callServer.

prompt.description: Natural-language description of the task you are working on. Returns the most relevant actions ranked by relevance.

k.description: Maximum number of ranked tools to return (default 25)

kArticles.description: Maximum number of article actions to return (default 5)

tools.name: callServer
tools.description: Call any MCP server's tool through the gateway. Enables dynamic access to any server's functionality by specifying the server name, tool name, and arguments.
